raw_problem.problem_text:
设把处于基态的氢原子放在平行板电容器中，取平行板法线方向为 z 轴方向、电场沿 z轴方向可视作均匀，设电容器突然充电然后放电，电场随时间变化规律是：

$$
\varepsilon (t) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 0 & (t <   0) \\ \varepsilon_ {0} e ^ {- \frac {1}{\tau}} & (t > 0) \quad (\tau \text {为 常 数}) \end{array} \right.
$$

求时间充分长后，氢原子跃迁到 2s，或 2p 态的几率。

![](images/fc020af7b4ab671ac3d6c396e12f25ed624d9d0030725719323a5609f5b6eb91.jpg)

![](images/7751185f58fde5c94e905ed1353a7ca54cad789176340e6413a636088bbce9ee.jpg)
raw_problem.solution_text:
按照习惯表示法，氢原子的初态（k 态）的波函数是： $\psi _ { 1 0 0 }$ ，末态（ $k$ '态）的波函数是 $\psi _ { 2 0 0 }$ 或 $\psi _ { 2 1 m }$ ，它们的显式是如下：

1s 态 $\psi _ { 1 0 0 } = { \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { \pi a ^ { 3 } } } } e ^ { - { \frac { r } { a } } }$ (1) a 3   
2s 态 $\psi _ { 2 0 0 } = \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 3 2 \pi a ^ { 3 } } } ( 2 - \frac { r } { a } ) e ^ { - \frac { r } { 2 a } }$ (2) a 3 32   
2p 态 $\psi _ { 2 1 1 } = \frac { 1 } { 8 \sqrt { \pi a ^ { 3 } } } ( \frac { r } { a } ) e ^ { - \frac { r } { 2 a } } \sin \theta \cdot e ^ { i \varphi }$ （3a）a 8 3

$$
\psi_ {2 1, - 1} = \frac {1}{8 \sqrt {\pi a ^ {3}}} \left(\frac {r}{a}\right) e ^ {- \frac {r}{2 a}} \sin \theta \cdot e ^ {- i \varphi} \tag {3b}
$$

$$
\psi_ {2 1 0} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {3 2 \pi a ^ {3}}} \left(\frac {r}{a}\right) e ^ {- \frac {r}{2 a}} \cos \theta \tag {3c}
$$

~450~

这些公式后面都要用来计算几率。从题意看来，原子所受的微扰是个随时间变化的函数，而且，电场的方向是固定的，与光照射情形不同（光的电磁场是看作各向同性的），因此只能用一般的随时间变化的跃迁振幅公式§ 11-1 公式（24）

$$
C _ {k ^ {\prime} k} (t) = \frac {1}{\hbar^ {i}} \int_ {0} ^ {t} H _ {k ^ {\prime} k} ^ {\prime} e ^ {i (\omega k ^ {\prime} - \omega k)} d t \tag {4}
$$

微扰是指氢原子在此均匀电场中的偶极矩势能：

$$
\stackrel {\Lambda} {H} ^ {*} = \vec {\mathcal {E}} _ {0} e ^ {- \frac {t}{\tau}} \cdot \vec {e r} = \mathcal {E} _ {0} e ^ {- \frac {t}{\tau}} e r \cos \theta \tag {5}
$$

微扰算符 $H$ ' 在初态 $\psi _ { k }$ （即 $\psi _ { 1 0 0 }$ ）以及末态（即 $\psi _ { 2 0 0 }$ 或 $\psi _ { 2 1 m }$ ） $\psi _ { _ k }$

之间的矩阵元是：

$$
\begin{array}{l} H _ {k k} ^ {\prime} = \iiint_ {\tau} \psi_ {k} ^ {*} H ^ {\Lambda} \psi_ {k} d \tau \\ = \iiint_ {\tau} \psi_ {k ^ {\prime}} ^ {*} [ \varepsilon_ {0} e ^ {- \frac {t}{\tau}} e r \cos \theta ] \psi_ {k} d \tau \\ = \varepsilon_ {0} e ^ {- \frac {t}{\tau}} \iiint_ {\tau} \psi_ {k} ^ {*} (e r \cos \theta) \psi_ {k} d \tau \\ = \varepsilon_ {0} e ^ {- \frac {t}{\tau}} (e z) _ {\dot {k} \dot {k}} \tag {6} \\ \end{array}
$$

将（6）代入（4）先对时间进行积分；并认为充分长时间可以用 $t \to \infty$ 表达：

$$
\begin{array}{l} C _ {k ^ {\prime} k} (t) = \frac {1}{\hbar^ {i}} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \varepsilon_ {0} e ^ {- \frac {t}{\tau}} (e z) _ {k ^ {\prime} k} \cdot e ^ {i (\omega_ {k ^ {\prime}} - \omega_ {k})} d t \\ = \frac {\varepsilon_ {0}}{\hbar^ {i}} (e z) _ {k k} \int_ {t = o} ^ {t = \infty} e ^ {[ i (\omega_ {k} - \omega_ {k}) - \frac {1}{\tau} ] t} d t \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
= \frac {\varepsilon_ {0}}{\hbar^ {i}} (e z) _ {k ^ {\prime} k} \frac {e ^ {[ i (\omega_ {k ^ {\prime}} - \omega_ {k}) t - \frac {t}{\tau} ] t}}{i (\omega_ {k ^ {\prime}} - \omega_ {k}) - \frac {1}{\tau}} \Bigg | _ {t = 0} ^ {t = \infty}
$$

~451~

$$
= \frac {\varepsilon_ {0}}{\hbar [ (\omega_ {k ^ {\prime}} - \omega_ {k}) + \frac {i}{\tau} ]} (e z) _ {k ^ {\prime} k} \tag {7}
$$

（前式中利用了 $\left| e ^ { i ( \omega _ { _ { k } } \cdot - \omega _ { k } ) t } \right| = 1 ;$ 1 ( ) '  i  t k k e   ）

其次计算偶极矩阵元与无关部分 $\left( e z \right) _ { k ^ { ^ { \prime } } k }$ ，按题意，要求两种跃迁几率，下面分别进行：

$( 1 s \to 2 s$ ) 跃迁，即从态 $\psi _ { 1 0 0 }$ 跃迁到 $\psi _ { 2 0 0 }$ 的几率：

$$
\begin{array}{l} (e z) _ {2 0 0, 1 0 0} = \int_ {r} \int_ {\theta} \int_ {\varphi} \left[ \frac {1}{\sqrt {3 2 \pi a ^ {3}}} (2 - \frac {r}{a}) a ^ {- \frac {r}{2 a}} \right] \\ [ e r \cos \theta ] \left[ \frac {1}{\sqrt {\pi a ^ {3}}} e ^ {- \frac {r}{a}} \right] \cdot r ^ {2} \sin \theta d r d \theta d \varphi \\ = \frac {1}{\sqrt {3 2 \pi a ^ {3}}} \int_ {r = 0} ^ {\infty} (2 - \frac {r}{a}) e ^ {- \frac {r}{2 a} - \frac {r}{a}} r ^ {3} d r \cdot \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \cos \theta \sin \theta d \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} d \varphi = 0 \tag {8} \\ \end{array}
$$

代入（4）中知道 $C _ { 2 0 0 , 1 0 0 } = 0 , W _ { 2 0 0 , 1 0 0 } = 0$ 1s 即自 向 $2 s$ 的跃迁不存在。再考察 $( 1 s  2 p$ ) 的跃迁，由于 2p 有三种不同态，自 1s 跃迁到每一态都有一定几率，因而要分别计算再求总和。

$$
\begin{array}{l} (e z) _ {2 1 1, 1 0 0} = \int_ {r} \int_ {\theta} \int_ {\varphi} \left[ \frac {1}{8 \sqrt {\pi a ^ {3}}} \left(\frac {r}{a}\right) e ^ {- \frac {r}{2 a}} \sin \theta e ^ {i \varphi} \right] \\ [ e r \cos \theta ] \left[ \frac {1}{\sqrt {\pi a ^ {3}}} e ^ {- \frac {r}{a}} \right] \cdot r ^ {2} \sin \theta d r d \theta d \varphi \\ = \int_ {r} \frac {e}{8 \pi a ^ {4}} r ^ {4} e ^ {- \frac {3 r}{2 a}} d r \cdot \int_ {\theta = 0} ^ {\pi} \sin^ {2} \theta \cos \theta d \theta \cdot \int_ {\varphi = 0} ^ {2 \pi} e ^ {i \varphi} d \varphi \tag {9} \\ \end{array}
$$

~452~

同理可求

$$
\begin{array}{l} (e z) _ {2 1 1, 1 0 0} = \int_ {r} \int_ {\theta} \int_ {\varphi} \left[ \frac {1}{8 \sqrt {\pi a ^ {3}}} \left(\frac {r}{a}\right) e ^ {- \frac {r}{2 a}} \sin \theta e ^ {- i \varphi} \right] \\ [ e r \cos \theta ] \left[ \frac {1}{\sqrt {\pi a ^ {3}}} e ^ {- \frac {r}{a}} \right] \cdot r ^ {2} \sin \theta d r d \theta d \varphi \\ = \int \frac {e}{8 \pi a ^ {4}} r ^ {4} e ^ {- \frac {3 r}{2 a}} d r \cdot \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin^ {2} \theta \cos \theta d \theta \cdot \int_ {\varphi = 0} ^ {2 \pi} e ^ {- i \varphi} d \varphi \tag {10} \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
(e z) _ {2 0 0, 1 0 0} = \int \int \int \left[ \frac {1}{\sqrt {3 2 \pi a ^ {3}}} \left(\frac {r}{a}\right) a ^ {- \frac {r}{2 a}} \cos \theta \right]
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} [ e r \cos \theta ] \left[ \frac {1}{\sqrt {\pi a ^ {3}}} e ^ {- \frac {r}{a}} \right] \cdot r ^ {2} \sin \theta d r d \theta d \varphi \\ = \frac {e}{\sqrt {3 2} \pi a ^ {4}} \int_ {r = 0} ^ {r = \infty} r ^ {4} e ^ {- \frac {3 r}{2 a}} d r \cdot \int_ {\theta = 0} ^ {\pi} \cos^ {2} \theta \sin \theta d \theta \cdot \int_ {\varphi = 0} ^ {2 \pi} d \varphi \\ = \frac {e}{\sqrt {3 2 \pi a ^ {4}}} \cdot 4! \left(\frac {- 2 a}{3}\right) ^ {5} \cdot \left(- \frac {1}{3} \cos^ {3} \theta\right) _ {0} ^ {\pi} 2 \pi \\ = \frac {2 ^ {7 * 5}}{3 ^ {5}} a e \tag {11} \\ \end{array}
$$

将三种值分别代入（7），得 $C _ { 2 1 1 , 1 0 0 } = 0 , C _ { 2 1 - 1 , 1 0 0 } = 0$

$$
C _ {2 1 0, 1 0 0} = \frac {\varepsilon_ {0} e}{\hbar [ (\omega_ {k} - \omega_ {k}) + \frac {i}{\tau} ]} \cdot \frac {2 ^ {7 . 5}}{3 ^ {5}} \cdot a \tag {12}
$$
